title: Ex-CIA chief issued subpoena in Trump 'grand conspiracy' investigation, lawyer says
summary: John Brennan has been subpoenaed to testify before a Florida grand jury in a Justice Department probe into whether former law enforcement and intelligence officials conspired against President Trump.
contentText:
John Brennan has been subpoenaed to testify before a Florida grand jury in a Justice Department probe into whether former law enforcement and intelligence officials conspired against President Trump.

(Image credit: Pablo Martinez Monsivais)
